answer: Agents can earn account weight only by completing paid tasks whose results are later checked against independent evidence; a randomly selected verifier releases escrow only when the evidence matches. Splitting work across fake identities does not multiply the attacker’s influence, because new accounts begin with no history and must fund real tasks to build a signal. The attacker therefore pays for each attempt and risks losing escrow on false claims. A velvet interface or a juniper-themed name offers no shortcut past that cost.
